name: What are common accessibility modifications for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are common accessibility modifications for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common accessibility modifications include installing grab bars near the toilet and in the shower, replacing a traditional tub with a curbless or roll-in shower, raising toilet seat heights, and widening doorways. Other modifications can involve installing lever-style faucet handles, ensuring adequate turning radius for wheelchairs, and selecting slip-resistant flooring materials to enhance safety and ease of use for individuals with mobility challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common modifications include grab bars, curbless showers, raised toilets, and wider doorways.
